channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Precious Achiuwa | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Precious Achiuwa from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scottie Barnes on Precious Achiuwa
item.description:
Scottie:

“I would say Precious. He has a lot of power, he can do a lot of tricks, he's very athletic. I wouldn't give it to myself... I don't really got bounce like that. I got a 40-inch vertical but I don't really know how to do the tricks”

Scottie Barnes on Precious Achiuwa, Mar 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Precious Achiuwa
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on Precious Achiuwa:

“Whatever's gotten into him since the all-star break, he's certainly been more decisive out there. He's catching and shooting fairly quickly, which means he's feeling confident, and I'm good with it.”

Nick Nurse on Precious Achiuwa, Mar 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Precious Achiuwa
item.description:
Wade said on NBA TV’s draft broadcast.

“Bam’s taken a beating down there. So, to have somebody that can come in and kind of play the same way . . . he’s a young Bam. Coming in, Bam couldn’t shoot early on, even though he was real athletic, great going to the rim, a great shot blocker. With the Heat’s ability to put the work in with these players and teach them the NBA game, (Precious) can develop into what Bam has now developed into. So I love this pick for us because it’s something that we needed, and something Bam needs to continue to stay at that All-Star level.”

Dwyane Wade on Precious Achiuwa, Nov 19, 2020. Source: The Athletic.
